info.name: Sariee Cart Bug Report (aurealis)
info.description:
For aurealis.sariee.shop.

UPDATE: 2 of the 3 previously-reported cart failures are now FIXED. ONE remains — checkout still cannot place an order.

[FIXED] BUG 1 — cart/add-update on an existing line: now returns 200 (C4).
[FIXED] BUG 2 — cart/init on a non-empty cart: now returns 200 (C5).
[STILL BROKEN] BUG 3 — Checkout.
  POST /api/frontend/checkout/checkout-action on a cart with items returns HTTP 500:
    {"status":false,"message":"Call to undefined method Modules\\Frontend\\App\\Models\\CartItem::isBundle()"}
  Reproduced 3/3 attempts with fresh carts. This blocks ALL orders — no customer can check out. The request payload is correct (same shape that created order a23783c8 previously; avail-methods still returns 200).
  ROOT CAUSE: the checkout code path calls CartItem::isBundle(), a method that isn't defined on Modules\Frontend\App\Models\CartItem — the same 'cart bundles' feature whose cart-side issues you just fixed; the checkout side still references the missing method.

HOW TO USE: Run the requests top to bottom (or 'Run collection'). C1 auto-fills the barcode id and mints a FRESH cart token. C2-C5 should now all be 200 (confirms the cart fixes). SCREENSHOT C6 — it is the remaining bug (500 isBundle).

Returns HTTP 200 (Cash On Delivery, paymentId 0). This is the exact step done right before checkout in the original working flow — included so the sequence matches production usage. Confirms cart + payment context are valid before C6.

*** THE REMAINING BUG — SCREENSHOT THIS *** Cash-On-Delivery checkout of the cart from C3 (payment_id 0). Correct payload (same shape that created order a23783c8 previously). Returns HTTP 500: {"status":false,"message":"Call to undefined method Modules\\Frontend\\App\\Models\\CartItem::isBundle()"}. Reproduced 3/3 with fresh carts. No order can be placed until CartItem::isBundle() is defined in the checkout path.
